entry.title: Minecraft: How to Build a Hobbit Home

media:group.media:title: Minecraft: How to Build a Hobbit Home
media:group.media:description:
After a long, unexpected journey, fighting off unknown and dangerous creatures, perhaps even a dragon, what better place to come back home to than this cozy hobbit home! Fitted with all your needs, from basic necessities such as a kitchen and a bedroom, to the more mystical enchanting room, or the spacious storage room, you'll have it all in this home.
Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/typfacemc/ Discord: https://discord.gg/DEsxq9k
You can find the world download on the Discord server!
Shaderpack I use: https://bitslablab.com/
Music from Hytale OST by Oscar Garvin: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=dgmVK0ldoA0 https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=V30-wKxYBw0 https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=-scz7eXNgik https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=FnTdLHAfEnk
Intro music by Johannes Bornlöf: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=mHI9ciR6ckA
